policy.workflow: word + POS + current Chinese meaning -> original sentence + zh-Hant-TW translation -> basic quality check

a.en: A good question can lead to a much deeper discussion.
a.zh: 一個好問題可以引導出更深入的討論。

a.m..en: The school library opens at nine a.m. on weekdays.
a.m..zh: 學校圖書館平日上午九點開門。

abandon.en: The hikers had to abandon their plan because of the storm.
abandon.zh: 登山客因為暴風雨而不得不放棄原本的計畫。

abbreviate.en: Writers often abbreviate long terms after introducing them clearly.
abbreviate.zh: 作者在清楚介紹長術語後，常會使用縮寫。

abide.en: All students must abide by the rules of the laboratory.
abide.zh: 所有學生都必須遵守實驗室規則。

ability.en: Practice can improve your ability to understand difficult reading passages.
ability.zh: 練習可以提升你理解困難閱讀文章的能力。

able.en: She was able to finish the report before the deadline.
able.zh: 她能夠在截止期限前完成報告。

abnormal.en: The doctor noticed an abnormal pattern in the test results.
abnormal.zh: 醫師注意到檢查結果中有異常的模式。

aboard.en: Everyone was safely aboard the train before it left the station.
aboard.zh: 火車離站前，每個人都已安全上車。

abolish.en: The school decided to abolish a rule that was no longer useful.
abolish.zh: 學校決定廢除一項已不再實用的規定。

aboriginal.en: The museum introduced aboriginal art from several regions of Taiwan.
aboriginal.zh: 博物館介紹了來自台灣數個地區的原住民藝術。

abortion.en: The textbook discussed abortion as a complex social and medical issue.
abortion.zh: 課本將墮胎作為一項複雜的社會與醫療議題來討論。

abound.en: Wildflowers abound in the valley during the warm spring months.
abound.zh: 溫暖的春季裡，山谷中遍布野花。

about.en: The class watched a short film about ocean pollution.
about.zh: 全班看了一部關於海洋污染的短片。

above.en: The temperature stayed above thirty degrees throughout the afternoon.
above.zh: 整個下午氣溫都維持在三十度以上。

abroad.en: She hopes to study abroad after graduating from high school.
abroad.zh: 她希望高中畢業後到國外留學。

abrupt.en: An abrupt change in weather forced us to return early.
abrupt.zh: 天氣突然改變，迫使我們提早返回。

absence.en: His absence from class made the group presentation more difficult.
absence.zh: 他的缺席讓小組報告變得更困難。

absent.en: Two students were absent because they were attending a competition.
absent.zh: 兩名學生因參加比賽而缺席。

absolute.en: There is no absolute answer to every question in social science.
absolute.zh: 社會科學中的每個問題都不一定有絕對答案。

absorb.en: Dark materials absorb more heat from sunlight than light materials.
absorb.zh: 深色材料比淺色材料吸收更多陽光的熱能。

abstract.en: The teacher used a diagram to explain an abstract idea.
abstract.zh: 老師用圖表來解釋一個抽象概念。

abstraction.en: The painting uses abstraction rather than realistic detail to express emotion.
abstraction.zh: 這幅畫以抽象手法而非寫實細節來表達情感。

absurd.en: It would be absurd to ignore all the evidence we collected.
absurd.zh: 忽略我們收集到的所有證據是很荒謬的。

abundance.en: The region is known for its abundance of fresh fruit.
abundance.zh: 這個地區以盛產新鮮水果聞名。

abundant.en: Clean water is abundant in some places but scarce in others.
abundant.zh: 乾淨的水在某些地方很充足，在其他地方卻很稀少。

abuse.en: The campaign teaches students how to recognize and report online abuse.
abuse.zh: 這項活動教導學生如何辨識並通報網路上的不當侵害。

academic.en: She received academic support when she struggled with mathematics.
academic.zh: 她在數學遇到困難時獲得了學業上的協助。

academy.en: He joined a summer academy that focused on science and engineering.
academy.zh: 他參加了一個以科學與工程為主的暑期學院課程。

accelerate.en: New technology can accelerate the process of collecting research data.
accelerate.zh: 新科技可以加快蒐集研究資料的過程。

accent.en: Her English accent changed slightly after living overseas for years.
accent.zh: 她在海外生活多年後，英語口音有些改變。

accept.en: We should accept useful feedback and learn from our mistakes.
accept.zh: 我們應該接受有用的回饋並從錯誤中學習。

acceptable.en: The teacher explained what level of evidence was acceptable for the report.
acceptable.zh: 老師說明了報告可接受的證據標準。

acceptance.en: The new policy gained wide acceptance among students and teachers.
acceptance.zh: 這項新政策獲得學生與教師的廣泛接受。

access.en: Students can access the online library with their school accounts.
access.zh: 學生可以使用學校帳號進入線上圖書館。

accessible.en: The website was redesigned to make information more accessible to everyone.
accessible.zh: 網站重新設計，使資訊更容易讓所有人取得。

accessory.en: This small accessory lets the camera connect to a larger screen.
accessory.zh: 這個小配件可以讓相機連接到較大的螢幕。

accident.en: The road was closed for an hour after a minor accident.
accident.zh: 一場小事故後，道路封閉了一個小時。

accidental.en: The discovery was accidental, but it led to an important experiment.
accidental.zh: 這項發現是偶然的，卻促成了一個重要實驗。

acclaim.en: The young musician earned acclaim for her first public performance.
acclaim.zh: 這位年輕音樂家因首次公開演出而獲得讚譽。

accommodate.en: The hall can accommodate more than five hundred visitors at once.
accommodate.zh: 這座大廳一次可以容納五百多名訪客。

accommodation.en: The exchange program provides accommodation for students near the school.
accommodation.zh: 交換計畫為學生提供學校附近的住宿。

accompany.en: A teacher will accompany the students during the museum visit.
accompany.zh: 博物館參訪期間會有一位老師陪同學生。

accomplish.en: The team worked together to accomplish its goal before Friday.
accomplish.zh: 團隊合作在星期五前完成目標。

accomplishment.en: Finishing the difficult project gave her a strong sense of accomplishment.
accomplishment.zh: 完成這項困難的專題讓她很有成就感。

accord.en: The two groups reached an accord after several hours of discussion.
accord.zh: 兩個團體經過數小時討論後達成協議。

accordance.en: The experiment was conducted in accordance with the safety guidelines.
accordance.zh: 這項實驗依照安全規範進行。

accordingly.en: The weather forecast changed, so we adjusted our schedule accordingly.
accordingly.zh: 天氣預報改變，因此我們也相應調整了行程。

account.en: Please create an account before saving your progress online.
account.zh: 請先建立帳號，再儲存你的線上進度。

accountable.en: Group members should be accountable for the tasks they agree to complete.
accountable.zh: 小組成員應對自己答應完成的任務負責。

accountant.en: The accountant checked the records carefully before preparing the report.
accountant.zh: 會計人員在準備報告前仔細檢查了紀錄。

accounting.en: She became interested in accounting after taking a business course.
accounting.zh: 她修讀商業課程後開始對會計感興趣。

accumulate.en: Small errors can accumulate and affect the final result.
accumulate.zh: 小錯誤可能逐漸累積並影響最後結果。

accumulation.en: The accumulation of plastic waste has become a serious environmental problem.
accumulation.zh: 塑膠垃圾的累積已成為嚴重的環境問題。

accuracy.en: The researchers repeated the test to improve the accuracy of their measurements.
accuracy.zh: 研究人員重複測試，以提高測量的準確度。

accurate.en: Make sure the numbers are accurate before submitting the report.
accurate.zh: 提交報告前要確認數字正確。

accusation.en: The accusation was investigated before any decision was made.
accusation.zh: 在做出任何決定前，相關指控先接受了調查。

accuse.en: It is unfair to accuse someone without enough evidence.
accuse.zh: 在沒有足夠證據的情況下指控他人是不公平的。

accustom.en: It may take time to accustom yourself to a new schedule.
accustom.zh: 你可能需要一些時間讓自己適應新的作息。

ache.en: My shoulders began to ache after carrying the heavy bag all day.
ache.zh: 背著沉重的包包一整天後，我的肩膀開始痠痛。

achieve.en: Regular practice can help students achieve better results over time.
achieve.zh: 規律練習能幫助學生逐漸取得更好的成果。

achievement.en: Winning the science contest was a major achievement for the team.
achievement.zh: 贏得科學競賽是這個團隊的一項重大成就。

acid.en: The experiment showed how acid reacts with certain types of metal.
acid.zh: 實驗展示酸如何與某些種類的金屬反應。

acknowledge.en: The report should acknowledge the limits of the available data.
acknowledge.zh: 這份報告應承認現有資料的限制。

acquaintance.en: I met an old acquaintance while visiting the night market.
acquaintance.zh: 我逛夜市時遇到一位舊識。

acquire.en: Students acquire new skills faster when they practice them regularly.
acquire.zh: 學生規律練習時能更快習得新技能。

acquisition.en: Language acquisition usually requires both exposure and repeated practice.
acquisition.zh: 語言習得通常需要接觸與反覆練習。

acre.en: The farm includes an acre of land beside the river.
acre.zh: 這座農場包含河邊的一英畝土地。

across.en: We walked across the bridge before the rain became heavier.
across.zh: 雨勢變大前，我們走過了那座橋。

act.en: Students should act responsibly when using information from the internet.
act.zh: 學生使用網路資訊時應負責任地行事。

action.en: Quick action prevented the small problem from becoming much worse.
action.zh: 迅速採取行動避免小問題變得更嚴重。

active.en: Staying active can improve both physical health and concentration.
active.zh: 保持活躍有助於改善身體健康與專注力。

activity.en: The teacher planned a short activity to review the new vocabulary.
activity.zh: 老師安排了一個簡短活動來複習新單字。

actor.en: The actor practiced the difficult scene several times before filming.
actor.zh: 這位演員在拍攝前把困難的場景練習了好幾次。

actress.en: The actress gave an interview about her latest film project.
actress.zh: 這位女演員接受訪問，談到她最新的電影計畫。

actual.en: The actual cost was lower than our original estimate.
actual.zh: 實際成本比我們原本的估算低。

adapt.en: Animals must adapt when their environment changes rapidly.
adapt.zh: 動物在環境快速改變時必須適應。

adaptation.en: The film is an adaptation of a well-known historical novel.
adaptation.zh: 這部電影改編自一部知名的歷史小說。

add.en: Please add your name to the list before leaving.
add.zh: 離開前請把你的名字加到名單上。

addition.en: The library's new study area is a useful addition to the school.
addition.zh: 圖書館的新自習區是學校一項實用的新設施。

additional.en: The teacher provided additional examples to make the idea clearer.
additional.zh: 老師提供更多例子，讓這個觀念更清楚。

address.en: The speaker will address several questions at the end of the talk.
address.zh: 講者會在演講最後回應幾個問題。

adequate.en: We need adequate time to check the data before publishing it.
adequate.zh: 我們需要足夠時間在發布資料前進行檢查。

adjust.en: You may need to adjust your study plan before the exam.
adjust.zh: 考試前你可能需要調整讀書計畫。

adjustment.en: A small adjustment to the schedule solved the timing problem.
adjustment.zh: 對行程做一點調整就解決了時間安排問題。

administer.en: Trained staff will administer the survey to all participating students.
administer.zh: 受過訓練的工作人員會對所有參與學生進行問卷調查。

administration.en: The school administration announced the new policy on Monday morning.
administration.zh: 校方在星期一早上宣布了新政策。

administrative.en: The office handles administrative tasks such as forms and scheduling.
administrative.zh: 這間辦公室處理表格與排程等行政工作。

admire.en: I admire people who remain calm during difficult situations.
admire.zh: 我很佩服在困難情況下仍能保持冷靜的人。

admission.en: Admission to the museum is free for students on Fridays.
admission.zh: 學生星期五可免費進入博物館。

admit.en: He was willing to admit his mistake and correct it.
admit.zh: 他願意承認自己的錯誤並加以改正。

adolescent.en: The study examined sleep habits among adolescent students.
adolescent.zh: 這項研究探討青少年學生的睡眠習慣。

adopt.en: The school plans to adopt a new online learning system.
adopt.zh: 學校計畫採用新的線上學習系統。

adult.en: Every adult in the program received basic first-aid training.
adult.zh: 計畫中的每位成年人都接受了基礎急救訓練。

advance.en: Medical research continues to advance through international cooperation.
advance.zh: 醫學研究透過國際合作持續進步。

advanced.en: The course introduces advanced topics after students master the basics.
advanced.zh: 學生掌握基礎後，這門課會介紹較進階的主題。

advantage.en: One advantage of online resources is that they are easy to update.
advantage.zh: 線上資源的一個優點是容易更新。

adventure.en: The trip became an unexpected adventure when our train was delayed.
adventure.zh: 火車誤點後，這趟旅程變成了一場意外的冒險。

advertise.en: The club used posters to advertise its upcoming school event.
advertise.zh: 社團用海報宣傳即將舉行的校內活動。

advertisement.en: The advertisement used bright images to attract young customers.
advertisement.zh: 這則廣告使用鮮明圖片吸引年輕顧客。

advice.en: Her advice helped me organize my study schedule more effectively.
advice.zh: 她的建議幫助我更有效率地安排讀書時間。

advise.en: Teachers often advise students to review difficult material regularly.
advise.zh: 老師常建議學生定期複習困難的內容。

advocate.en: Many scientists advocate stronger action to protect natural habitats.
advocate.zh: 許多科學家主張採取更積極的行動保護自然棲地。

affair.en: The committee is responsible for student affair planning and campus events.
affair.zh: 這個委員會負責學生事務規劃與校園活動。

affect.en: Cold weather can affect how quickly some plants grow.
affect.zh: 寒冷天氣會影響某些植物的生長速度。

affection.en: The child showed affection for the dog by gently petting it.
affection.zh: 孩子輕輕撫摸小狗，表達對牠的喜愛。

afford.en: We cannot afford to waste time before the final deadline.
afford.zh: 在最後期限前，我們不能浪費時間。

afraid.en: She was afraid of making mistakes during her first speech.
afraid.zh: 她第一次演講時很害怕犯錯。

after.en: We discussed the results after everyone finished the experiment.
after.zh: 每個人完成實驗後，我們一起討論結果。

afternoon.en: The class will meet again tomorrow afternoon in the library.
afternoon.zh: 全班明天下午會在圖書館再次集合。

afterward.en: We finished the presentation and talked about the experience afterward.
afterward.zh: 我們完成報告後，又聊了聊這次經驗。

again.en: Please read the question again before choosing your final answer.
again.zh: 選擇最後答案前，請再讀一次題目。

against.en: The team played against a strong opponent in the final match.
against.zh: 這支隊伍在決賽中對上一個強勁的對手。

age.en: People of every age can benefit from regular physical activity.
age.zh: 各個年齡層的人都能從規律運動中受益。

agency.en: The government agency released a report on air quality.
agency.zh: 政府機關發布了一份空氣品質報告。

agenda.en: The first item on today's agenda is the class project.
agenda.zh: 今天議程的第一項是班級專題。

agent.en: The travel agent helped us compare several transportation options.
agent.zh: 旅行社人員幫我們比較了幾種交通選項。

aggressive.en: The coach warned that aggressive behavior would not be accepted.
aggressive.zh: 教練警告說，具攻擊性的行為不會被接受。

ago.en: We visited the same museum two years ago during a school trip.
ago.zh: 兩年前校外教學時，我們參觀過同一間博物館。

agree.en: Most group members agree that the second plan is more practical.
agree.zh: 大多數組員都同意第二個計畫比較實際。

agreement.en: The two teams reached an agreement about how to divide the work.
agreement.zh: 兩個團隊就如何分工達成協議。

agriculture.en: Modern agriculture increasingly uses technology to save water and energy.
agriculture.zh: 現代農業越來越常利用科技節省水與能源。

ahead.en: We finished the assignment ahead of schedule and checked it twice.
ahead.zh: 我們提前完成作業，並檢查了兩次。

aid.en: The new program provides financial aid to students who need support.
aid.zh: 這項新計畫為需要協助的學生提供經濟援助。

aim.en: The project aims to reduce waste, and this is its main aim.
aim.zh: 這項計畫旨在減少浪費，而這也是它的主要目標。

air.en: Fresh air entered the room when we opened the windows.
air.zh: 我們打開窗戶後，新鮮空氣進入房間。

aircraft.en: The museum displays an aircraft used for early scientific research.
aircraft.zh: 博物館展示了一架早期科學研究使用的飛機。

airline.en: The airline changed our flight time because of bad weather.
airline.zh: 航空公司因天候不佳更改了我們的班機時間。

airport.en: We arrived at the airport two hours before departure.
airport.zh: 我們在起飛前兩小時抵達機場。

alarm.en: The fire alarm sounded during class, so everyone left calmly.
alarm.zh: 上課期間火警警報響起，因此大家冷靜離開。

album.en: She created a photo album to remember the class trip.
album.zh: 她製作了一本相簿來紀念班級旅行。

alcohol.en: The chemistry lesson explained how alcohol behaves in different reactions.
alcohol.zh: 化學課說明了酒精在不同反應中的性質。

alert.en: The weather service issued an alert before the heavy rain began.
alert.zh: 大雨開始前，氣象單位發布了警報。

alien.en: The novel imagines an alien society living on a distant planet.
alien.zh: 這本小說想像一個生活在遙遠星球上的外星社會。

alike.en: The two designs look alike, but they work in different ways.
alike.zh: 這兩個設計看起來相似，但運作方式不同。

alive.en: The plant stayed alive because we watered it regularly.
alive.zh: 因為我們定期澆水，這株植物一直存活著。

all.en: All students must submit the form before Friday afternoon.
all.zh: 所有學生都必須在星期五下午前交表格。

allow.en: The new rule will allow students to borrow more books.
allow.zh: 新規定將允許學生借更多本書。

allowance.en: Her monthly allowance is divided between savings and daily expenses.
allowance.zh: 她每月的零用錢分成儲蓄與日常花費。

almost.en: We almost missed the bus because the meeting ended late.
almost.zh: 因為會議太晚結束，我們差點錯過公車。

alone.en: He studied alone for an hour before joining his group.
alone.zh: 他先獨自讀了一小時書，才加入小組。

along.en: We walked along the river and recorded the plants we saw.
along.zh: 我們沿著河走，並記錄看到的植物。

alongside.en: Students worked alongside local volunteers during the cleanup activity.
alongside.zh: 學生在清潔活動中與當地志工一起工作。

aloud.en: The teacher asked each student to read one sentence aloud.
aloud.zh: 老師請每位學生大聲朗讀一句話。

alphabet.en: Children usually learn the alphabet before they begin reading simple words.
alphabet.zh: 孩子通常先學會字母表，才開始閱讀簡單單字。

already.en: I had already finished the homework when my friend called.
already.zh: 朋友打電話來時，我已經完成作業了。

also.en: The course teaches writing skills and also includes speaking practice.
also.zh: 這門課教授寫作技巧，也包含口說練習。

alter.en: Even a small change can alter the outcome of the experiment.
alter.zh: 即使小小的改變也可能改變實驗結果。

alternative.en: We prepared an alternative route in case the main road closed.
alternative.zh: 我們準備了替代路線，以防主要道路封閉。

although.en: Although the task was difficult, the group completed it successfully.
although.zh: 雖然任務很困難，小組仍成功完成了。

altogether.en: Altogether, the class collected more than five hundred books.
altogether.zh: 全班總共募集了五百多本書。

always.en: Always check the source before sharing information online.
always.zh: 在網路上分享資訊前，務必先查證來源。

amateur.en: The amateur photographer won a prize in the local contest.
amateur.zh: 這位業餘攝影師在地方比賽中獲獎。

amaze.en: The clear night sky can amaze visitors from crowded cities.
amaze.zh: 清澈的夜空可能讓來自擁擠城市的訪客感到驚嘆。

ambassador.en: The ambassador spoke to students about international cooperation and culture.
ambassador.zh: 大使向學生談到國際合作與文化。

ambition.en: Her ambition is to become an engineer and solve practical problems.
ambition.zh: 她的志向是成為工程師並解決實際問題。

ambitious.en: The students proposed an ambitious plan to reduce campus waste.
ambitious.zh: 學生提出了一項雄心勃勃的校園減廢計畫。

ambulance.en: An ambulance arrived quickly after someone called for medical help.
ambulance.zh: 有人求助醫療後，救護車很快就抵達了。

among.en: The teacher divided the tasks among the five group members.
among.zh: 老師把任務分配給五位組員。

amount.en: A small amount of daily practice can produce steady improvement.
amount.zh: 每天少量練習也能帶來穩定進步。

amuse.en: The funny story was meant to amuse the children during the wait.
amuse.zh: 這個有趣的故事是為了在等待時逗孩子開心。

analysis.en: Careful analysis of the data revealed a clear pattern.
analysis.zh: 仔細分析資料後發現了一個明顯的模式。

analyze.en: We need to analyze the evidence before drawing a conclusion.
analyze.zh: 我們需要先分析證據，再下結論。

ancestor.en: The exhibit explains how an ancestor of the species may have lived.
ancestor.zh: 展覽說明這個物種的祖先可能如何生活。

ancient.en: Archaeologists discovered ancient tools near the river last year.
ancient.zh: 考古學家去年在河邊發現了古代工具。

and.en: Reading and writing skills usually improve through regular practice.
and.zh: 閱讀和寫作能力通常會透過規律練習而進步。

anger.en: He learned to manage his anger before responding to criticism.
anger.zh: 他學會在回應批評前先控制自己的怒氣。

angle.en: Measure the angle carefully before drawing the final diagram.
angle.zh: 畫最後的圖之前要仔細測量角度。

angry.en: She felt angry at first but chose to discuss the problem calmly.
angry.zh: 她一開始很生氣，但選擇冷靜討論問題。

animal.en: Each animal in the study was observed without being disturbed.
animal.zh: 研究中的每隻動物都在不受干擾的情況下被觀察。

ankle.en: He injured his ankle during practice and rested for several days.
ankle.zh: 他練習時腳踝受傷，因此休息了好幾天。

announce.en: The school will announce the contest results tomorrow morning.
announce.zh: 學校將在明天早上公布比賽結果。

announcement.en: The principal made an announcement about next week's schedule.
announcement.zh: 校長宣布了下週的行程安排。

annual.en: The annual science fair attracts students from many nearby schools.
annual.zh: 年度科展吸引許多鄰近學校的學生參加。

another.en: We tried another method after the first one failed.
another.zh: 第一個方法失敗後，我們又試了另一個方法。

answer.en: Please explain how you reached your answer instead of guessing.
answer.zh: 請說明你如何得到答案，而不是猜測。

ant.en: An ant can carry objects much heavier than its own body.
ant.zh: 螞蟻可以搬動比自己身體重得多的物體。

anticipate.en: We anticipate more visitors during the holiday weekend.
anticipate.zh: 我們預期連假期間會有更多訪客。

anxiety.en: Good preparation can reduce anxiety before an important exam.
anxiety.zh: 充分準備可以減輕重要考試前的焦慮。

anxious.en: She felt anxious before speaking in front of the class.
anxious.zh: 她在全班面前發言前感到焦慮。

any.en: If you have any questions, write them at the bottom.
any.zh: 如果你有任何問題，請寫在下方。

anybody.en: Anybody can join the club if they are interested in science.
anybody.zh: 任何對科學有興趣的人都可以加入這個社團。

anyone.en: Anyone who finishes early may begin the next activity.
anyone.zh: 任何提早完成的人都可以開始下一個活動。

anything.en: Do not change anything until the experiment has completely finished.
anything.zh: 實驗完全結束前，不要改動任何東西。

anyway.en: The weather was cloudy, but we decided to go anyway.
anyway.zh: 天氣多雲，但我們還是決定出發。

anywhere.en: You can study anywhere if you have a quiet space.
anywhere.zh: 只要有安靜的空間，你在哪裡都可以讀書。

apart.en: The two buildings are only a few meters apart.
apart.zh: 這兩棟建築物只相隔幾公尺。

apartment.en: Her apartment is close enough to walk to school.
apartment.zh: 她的公寓離學校很近，可以走路上學。

apologize.en: You should apologize when your mistake causes trouble for others.
apologize.zh: 當你的錯誤造成別人困擾時，你應該道歉。

apology.en: He offered a sincere apology after realizing what had happened.
apology.zh: 他了解發生什麼事後，真誠地道歉。

apparent.en: It became apparent that the original plan would take too long.
apparent.zh: 很明顯地，原本的計畫會花太多時間。

appeal.en: The idea may appeal to students who enjoy learning through games.
appeal.zh: 這個想法可能會吸引喜歡透過遊戲學習的學生。

appear.en: New problems may appear when a system becomes more complex.
appear.zh: 系統變得更複雜時，可能會出現新的問題。

appearance.en: The product's appearance changed, but its main function stayed the same.
appearance.zh: 產品的外觀改變了，但主要功能維持不變。

appetite.en: A long hike can give you a strong appetite.
appetite.zh: 長時間健行會讓你很有食慾。

applaud.en: The audience began to applaud when the performance ended.
applaud.zh: 表演結束時，觀眾開始鼓掌。

apple.en: She packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.
apple.zh: 她午餐帶了一顆蘋果和一份三明治。

applicant.en: Each applicant must submit the form before the deadline.
applicant.zh: 每位申請者都必須在截止日前提交表格。

application.en: Your application should include a short statement about your goals.
application.zh: 你的申請資料應包含一段關於目標的簡短說明。

apply.en: Students can apply for the program through the school website.
apply.zh: 學生可以透過學校網站申請這項計畫。

appoint.en: The club will appoint a new leader at next week's meeting.
appoint.zh: 社團將在下週的會議任命新的負責人。

appointment.en: I made an appointment with the teacher to discuss my project.
appointment.zh: 我和老師約了時間討論我的專題。

appreciate.en: I appreciate your help with checking the final report.
appreciate.zh: 我很感謝你幫忙檢查最後的報告。

approach.en: We need a different approach to solve this complicated problem.
approach.zh: 我們需要用不同的方法解決這個複雜問題。

appropriate.en: Choose an appropriate source for an academic research report.
appropriate.zh: 請為學術研究報告選擇適當的資料來源。

approval.en: The project cannot begin until we receive official approval.
approval.zh: 這項計畫必須等到獲得正式批准後才能開始。

approve.en: The committee will approve the plan if it meets the requirements.
approve.zh: 如果計畫符合要求，委員會就會批准。

architect.en: The architect designed the building to use more natural light.
architect.zh: 建築師設計這棟建築時增加了自然採光。

architecture.en: The city is famous for its mixture of old and modern architecture.
architecture.zh: 這座城市以新舊建築風格並存而聞名。

area.en: This area becomes crowded during the evening rush hour.
area.zh: 這個地區在晚間尖峰時段會變得很擁擠。

argue.en: Students should argue their position with evidence rather than emotion.
argue.zh: 學生應以證據而不是情緒來論證自己的立場。

argument.en: A strong argument needs clear reasoning and reliable evidence.
argument.zh: 有力的論點需要清楚的推理與可靠的證據。

arise.en: Unexpected problems may arise when plans change at the last minute.
arise.zh: 計畫在最後一刻改變時，可能會出現意料之外的問題。

arm.en: He raised his arm to ask the teacher a question.
arm.zh: 他舉起手臂向老師提問。

army.en: The museum exhibition explains the army's role in the historical event.
army.zh: 博物館展覽說明軍隊在這起歷史事件中的角色。

around.en: We walked around the campus before the first class began.
around.zh: 第一節課開始前，我們繞著校園走了一圈。

arrange.en: Please arrange the books by subject before returning them.
arrange.zh: 歸還書籍前，請依科目整理排列。

arrangement.en: The seating arrangement made group discussion much easier.
arrangement.zh: 座位安排讓小組討論變得容易許多。

arrest.en: Police may arrest a suspect when there is sufficient legal evidence.
arrest.zh: 警方在有足夠法律證據時可能逮捕嫌疑人。

arrival.en: We checked the train's arrival time before leaving home.
arrival.zh: 出門前我們先確認了火車抵達時間。

arrive.en: Please arrive ten minutes early so the meeting can start on time.
arrive.zh: 請提早十分鐘到達，讓會議能準時開始。

arrow.en: The arrow on the map shows which direction to walk.
arrow.zh: 地圖上的箭頭顯示應該往哪個方向走。

art.en: Art can help people express ideas that are difficult to explain.
art.zh: 藝術可以幫助人們表達難以用言語說明的想法。

article.en: The article explains several causes of climate change.
article.zh: 這篇文章說明了氣候變遷的幾個原因。

artificial.en: The laboratory used artificial light to control the growing conditions.
artificial.zh: 實驗室使用人工光線控制生長條件。

artist.en: The artist used recycled materials to create the sculpture.
artist.zh: 藝術家使用回收材料創作這座雕塑。

as.en: As the weather improved, more people returned to the park.
as.zh: 隨著天氣好轉，更多人回到公園。

ash.en: A thin layer of ash covered the ground after the eruption.
ash.zh: 火山爆發後，地面覆蓋了一層薄薄的火山灰。

aside.en: She put her phone aside and focused on the discussion.
aside.zh: 她把手機放到一旁，專心參與討論。

ask.en: Please ask for help if the instructions are unclear.
ask.zh: 如果說明不清楚，請主動求助。

asleep.en: He fell asleep quickly after a long day of travel.
asleep.zh: 經過一整天的旅行後，他很快就睡著了。

aspect.en: The report examines one important aspect of online learning.
aspect.zh: 這份報告探討線上學習的一個重要面向。

assault.en: The report examined how communities can prevent assault and improve public safety.
assault.zh: 這份報告探討社區如何預防暴力攻擊並提升公共安全。

assemble.en: Students will assemble the model after reading the instructions carefully.
assemble.zh: 學生仔細閱讀說明後會組裝模型。

assembly.en: The school assembly begins at eight thirty tomorrow morning.
assembly.zh: 明天早上八點半舉行全校集會。

assert.en: The writer should not assert a claim without supporting evidence.
assert.zh: 作者不應在沒有支持證據的情況下斷言。

assess.en: Teachers use several methods to assess student progress fairly.
assess.zh: 老師使用多種方法公平評估學生的學習進度。

assessment.en: The final assessment includes both a written test and a presentation.
assessment.zh: 期末評量包含筆試與口頭報告。

assign.en: The teacher will assign each group a different research topic.
assign.zh: 老師會分配給每組不同的研究主題。

assignment.en: I finished the assignment before starting my other homework.
assignment.zh: 我先完成這份作業，才開始做其他功課。

assist.en: Several volunteers will assist visitors during the school exhibition.
assist.zh: 幾位志工會在校內展覽期間協助訪客。

assistance.en: Please ask for assistance if you cannot find the correct room.
assistance.zh: 如果找不到正確教室，請尋求協助。

assistant.en: The laboratory assistant prepared the equipment before the experiment began.
assistant.zh: 實驗助理在實驗開始前準備好器材。

associate.en: People often associate certain songs with important memories.
associate.zh: 人們常把某些歌曲與重要回憶聯想在一起。

association.en: The study found an association between regular exercise and better sleep.
association.zh: 研究發現規律運動與較佳睡眠之間有所關聯。

assume.en: Do not assume the result is correct before checking the data.
assume.zh: 在檢查資料前，不要假設結果一定正確。

assure.en: The teacher tried to assure us that enough time remained.
assure.zh: 老師試著讓我們放心，表示時間還很充足。

astonish.en: The speed of the recovery continued to astonish the researchers.
astonish.zh: 恢復的速度持續讓研究人員感到驚訝。

at.en: We will meet at the library entrance after school.
at.zh: 放學後我們會在圖書館入口集合。

athlete.en: The athlete follows a careful training and rest schedule.
athlete.zh: 這名運動員遵循仔細安排的訓練與休息計畫。

athletic.en: The school offers several athletic programs for interested students.
athletic.zh: 學校為有興趣的學生提供多種運動課程。

atmosphere.en: The quiet atmosphere of the library helps me concentrate.
atmosphere.zh: 圖書館安靜的氣氛有助於我專心。

attach.en: Please attach the file before sending the email to your teacher.
attach.zh: 寄信給老師前，請先附上檔案。

attack.en: The article describes how plants defend themselves from insect attack.
attack.zh: 這篇文章描述植物如何防禦昆蟲攻擊。

attempt.en: Her first attempt failed, but she learned from the experience.
attempt.zh: 她第一次嘗試失敗了，但從經驗中學到很多。

attend.en: All group members should attend the meeting on Friday afternoon.
attend.zh: 所有組員都應參加星期五下午的會議。

attendance.en: Regular attendance is important because each lesson builds on the previous one.
attendance.zh: 規律出席很重要，因為每堂課都建立在前一堂課的內容上。

attention.en: Pay close attention to the units when reading the graph.
attention.zh: 閱讀圖表時要特別注意單位。

attitude.en: A positive attitude can make difficult learning tasks feel more manageable.
attitude.zh: 正向態度能讓困難的學習任務感覺比較容易應付。

attract.en: Bright flowers attract insects that help the plants reproduce.
attract.zh: 鮮豔的花朵會吸引幫助植物繁殖的昆蟲。

attraction.en: The night market is a popular attraction for visitors to the city.
attraction.zh: 夜市是造訪這座城市的旅客喜愛的景點。

attractive.en: The new study area is both comfortable and attractive.
attractive.zh: 新的自習區既舒適又美觀。

audience.en: The speaker asked the audience to save questions until the end.
audience.zh: 講者請聽眾把問題留到最後再問。

aunt.en: My aunt taught me how to cook this simple dish.
aunt.zh: 我的阿姨教我如何做這道簡單的料理。

author.en: The author uses several examples to support the main idea.
author.zh: 作者使用幾個例子來支持主旨。

authority.en: The local authority published new safety guidelines for the area.
authority.zh: 地方主管機關公布了這個地區的新安全指引。

automatic.en: The doors have an automatic system that opens when someone approaches.
automatic.zh: 這些門有自動系統，有人靠近時就會開啟。

automobile.en: The museum displays an early automobile from the beginning of the twentieth century.
automobile.zh: 博物館展示了一輛二十世紀初期的早期汽車。

available.en: Several study rooms are available for students after school.
available.zh: 放學後有幾間自習室可供學生使用。

avenue.en: We walked down the avenue toward the main train station.
avenue.zh: 我們沿著大道往主要火車站走去。

average.en: The average score increased after students received more practice.
average.zh: 學生獲得更多練習後，平均分數提高了。

avoid.en: Try to avoid checking your phone while you are studying.
avoid.zh: 讀書時盡量避免查看手機。

awake.en: I stayed awake long enough to finish reading the chapter.
awake.zh: 我保持清醒，直到把這一章讀完。

award.en: The school will award a prize to the winning team.
award.zh: 學校將頒獎給獲勝的隊伍。

aware.en: Students should be aware of how online information can be misleading.
aware.zh: 學生應該了解網路資訊可能具有誤導性。

away.en: The station is only a ten-minute walk away from our school.
away.zh: 車站離我們學校走路只要十分鐘。

awesome.en: The view from the mountain was awesome after the clouds cleared.
awesome.zh: 雲散後，山上的景色令人驚嘆。

awful.en: The weather was awful, so the outdoor event was canceled.
awful.zh: 天氣非常糟，因此戶外活動被取消了。

behavior.en: The study focused on how stress influences student behavior.
behavior.zh: 這項研究著重於壓力如何影響學生行為。

benefit.en: Regular exercise can benefit both physical and mental health.
benefit.zh: 規律運動對身心健康都有好處。

body.en: Regular sleep helps the body recover from a busy day.
body.zh: 規律睡眠有助於身體從忙碌的一天中恢復。

challenge.en: Learning to manage time well is a common challenge for students.
challenge.zh: 學會做好時間管理是學生常見的挑戰。

circumstance.en: Under this circumstance, waiting for more information is the safest choice.
circumstance.zh: 在這種情況下，等待更多資訊是最安全的選擇。

come.en: New ideas often come from asking simple but important questions.
come.zh: 新想法常來自提出簡單但重要的問題。

community.en: The new library has become an important place for the local community.
community.zh: 這座新圖書館已成為當地社區的重要場所。

concept.en: The teacher used a simple diagram to explain the concept.
concept.zh: 老師用簡單的圖示解釋這個概念。

consequence.en: One consequence of poor planning is having to rush at the end.
consequence.zh: 規劃不佳的一個後果是最後必須趕工。

consider.en: You should consider several choices before making an important decision.
consider.zh: 做重要決定前，你應該考慮幾個不同的選擇。

context.en: You can often guess a word's meaning from the context around it.
context.zh: 你常可以從周圍的語境猜出單字的意思。

contrast.en: The essay draws a clear contrast between city and country life.
contrast.zh: 這篇文章清楚對比城市與鄉村生活。

contribute.en: Every group member should contribute at least one useful idea.
contribute.zh: 每位組員都應至少貢獻一個有用的想法。

country.en: Each country has its own traditions, laws, and education system.
country.zh: 每個國家都有自己的傳統、法律與教育制度。

decision.en: She considered several options carefully before making her final decision.
decision.zh: 她在做最後決定前仔細考慮了幾個選項。

define.en: The teacher asked us to define the term in our own words.
define.zh: 老師要我們用自己的話定義這個術語。

demonstrate.en: The experiment can demonstrate how pressure changes the behavior of gases.
demonstrate.zh: 這個實驗可以示範壓力如何改變氣體的行為。

develop.en: Students need time to develop strong reading and writing skills.
develop.zh: 學生需要時間培養扎實的閱讀與寫作能力。

distribution.en: The graph shows the distribution of scores across the whole class.
distribution.zh: 這張圖表顯示全班分數的分布情形。

economic.en: The report discusses several economic problems facing the country.
economic.zh: 這份報告討論該國面臨的幾項經濟問題。

environment.en: A quiet environment can make it easier to focus on studying.
environment.zh: 安靜的環境能讓人更容易專心讀書。

establish.en: The school hopes to establish a stronger reading culture among students.
establish.zh: 學校希望在學生之間建立更強的閱讀風氣。

estimate.en: We can estimate the total cost before making the final decision.
estimate.zh: 我們可以在做最後決定前估算總成本。

even.en: Even a short review can help you remember important ideas.
even.zh: 即使只是短暫複習，也能幫助你記住重要觀念。

evidence.en: The scientist looked for evidence before accepting the new explanation.
evidence.zh: 科學家在接受新的解釋前先尋找證據。

experience.en: Traveling alone gave him valuable experience in solving unexpected problems.
experience.zh: 獨自旅行讓他獲得處理突發問題的寶貴經驗。

factor.en: Sleep is an important factor in both health and learning.
factor.zh: 睡眠是影響健康與學習的重要因素。

feature.en: One useful feature of the app is its offline mode.
feature.zh: 這個應用程式的一項實用功能是離線模式。

find.en: You can find useful information on the library website.
find.zh: 你可以在圖書館網站上找到實用資訊。

function.en: This button has a useful function that saves your recent work.
function.zh: 這個按鈕有一項實用功能，可以儲存你最近的工作。

get.en: You will get better results if you review a little every day.
get.zh: 如果你每天複習一點，就會得到更好的成果。

go.en: We decided to go home before the weather became worse.
go.zh: 我們決定在天氣變差前先回家。

good.en: A good study plan should include both practice and rest.
good.zh: 好的讀書計畫應同時包含練習與休息。

however.en: The task looked difficult; however, we completed it on time.
however.zh: 這項任務看起來很困難；然而，我們仍準時完成了。

human.en: Human behavior can change when the environment changes suddenly.
human.zh: 當環境突然改變時，人類行為也可能跟著改變。

identify.en: Students should identify the main idea before reading the details.
identify.zh: 學生應先找出主旨，再閱讀細節。

impact.en: Social media can have a strong impact on how people receive news.
impact.zh: 社群媒體可能大幅影響人們接收新聞的方式。

indicate.en: The survey results indicate that students want more practice time.
indicate.zh: 調查結果顯示，學生希望有更多練習時間。

individual.en: Each individual may respond differently to the same situation.
individual.zh: 每個人對同一情況可能有不同反應。

information.en: The website provides useful information about scholarships and application deadlines.
information.zh: 這個網站提供有關獎學金與申請截止日期的實用資訊。

involve.en: The project will involve students from three different classes.
involve.zh: 這項專題將會有三個不同班級的學生參與。

issue.en: The class discussed an environmental issue that affects many cities.
issue.zh: 全班討論了一個影響許多城市的環境議題。

know.en: It is useful to know why an answer is correct.
know.zh: 知道一個答案為什麼正確是很有幫助的。

like.en: Many students like to review vocabulary before going to bed.
like.zh: 許多學生喜歡在睡前複習單字。

likely.en: Students who review regularly are more likely to remember new vocabulary.
likely.zh: 規律複習的學生更可能記住新單字。

maintain.en: It is easier to maintain a habit when you practice it regularly.
maintain.zh: 規律練習會讓維持一個習慣變得更容易。

major.en: Traffic is a major problem in many large cities.
major.zh: 交通是許多大城市的一項主要問題。

make.en: Small daily choices can make a big difference over time.
make.zh: 每天的小選擇久而久之可能帶來很大的改變。

mean.en: What does this sentence mean in the context of the passage?
mean.zh: 這個句子在文章語境中是什麼意思？

measure.en: The experiment used a digital scale to measure the amount of water.
measure.zh: 實驗使用電子秤測量水的量。

method.en: The teacher introduced a simple method for remembering difficult vocabulary.
method.zh: 老師介紹了一個記住困難單字的簡單方法。

new.en: The school introduced a new course on environmental science this year.
new.zh: 學校今年開設了一門新的環境科學課程。

occur.en: Mistakes often occur when people work too quickly without checking details.
occur.zh: 人們做事太快又沒有檢查細節時，常會發生錯誤。

often.en: Students often remember new words better when they use them in context.
often.zh: 學生在語境中使用新單字時，通常會記得更牢。

only.en: This ticket is only valid until the end of today.
only.zh: 這張票只有效到今天結束為止。

other.en: Some students prefer reading, while other students learn better by listening.
other.zh: 有些學生偏好閱讀，而其他學生用聽的學得更好。

out.en: We went out after class to buy something to eat.
out.zh: 下課後我們出去買了些東西吃。

participate.en: More students decided to participate in the school volunteer program.
participate.zh: 更多學生決定參加學校的志工計畫。

person.en: Every person in the group was asked to share one idea.
person.zh: 小組中的每個人都被要求分享一個想法。

potential.en: The new plan has the potential to improve student participation.
potential.zh: 這項新計畫有提升學生參與度的潛力。

principle.en: The teacher explained the basic principle behind the experiment.
principle.zh: 老師解釋了這項實驗背後的基本原理。

process.en: Learning a language is a gradual process that requires regular practice.
process.zh: 學習語言是一個需要規律練習的漸進過程。

reason.en: There is a clear reason why this method works better.
reason.zh: 這個方法為什麼效果更好有一個明確的原因。

relationship.en: The study examined the relationship between exercise and sleep quality.
relationship.zh: 這項研究探討運動與睡眠品質之間的關係。

require.en: This assignment will require careful reading and clear written explanations.
require.zh: 這份作業需要仔細閱讀以及清楚的書面說明。

research.en: The students conducted research on how sleep affects learning and memory.
research.zh: 學生研究睡眠如何影響學習與記憶。

resource.en: The library website is a useful resource for finding reliable information.
resource.zh: 圖書館網站是尋找可靠資訊的實用資源。

response.en: Her response showed that she had understood the question clearly.
response.zh: 她的回答顯示她已清楚理解這個問題。

responsibility.en: Students have a responsibility to complete their own work honestly.
responsibility.zh: 學生有責任誠實完成自己的作業。

result.en: The final result was better than we had expected.
result.zh: 最後的結果比我們原先預期的更好。

role.en: Parents can play an important role in supporting a student's learning.
role.zh: 家長可以在支持學生學習方面扮演重要角色。

section.en: Read the first section carefully before answering the questions below.
section.zh: 回答下方問題前，請先仔細閱讀第一部分。

see.en: You can see the difference clearly when the two charts are compared.
see.zh: 比較兩張圖表時，你可以清楚看出差異。

show.en: The results show that most students prefer shorter study sessions.
show.zh: 結果顯示，多數學生偏好較短的讀書時段。

significant.en: The experiment showed a significant improvement after the method was changed.
significant.zh: 方法改變後，實驗顯示出明顯的改善。

similar.en: The two experiments produced similar results under the same conditions.
similar.zh: 兩個實驗在相同條件下得到相似的結果。

situation.en: We need more information before we can understand the whole situation.
situation.zh: 我們需要更多資訊才能了解整個情況。

source.en: Always check whether a source is reliable before using its information.
source.zh: 使用資料前，務必先確認來源是否可靠。

specific.en: Please give a specific example to support your main point.
specific.zh: 請舉出一個具體例子來支持你的主要觀點。

standard.en: The final report must meet the standard required by the teacher.
standard.zh: 期末報告必須達到老師要求的標準。

strategy.en: She changed her study strategy after noticing which methods worked best.
strategy.zh: 她發現哪些方法最有效後，調整了自己的讀書策略。

structure.en: A clear structure makes an essay easier to read and understand.
structure.zh: 清楚的結構會讓文章更容易閱讀與理解。

suggest.en: The results suggest that regular practice improves long-term memory.
suggest.zh: 結果顯示，規律練習有助於提升長期記憶。

support.en: Good evidence can support an argument and make it more convincing.
support.zh: 良好的證據能支持論點，讓它更有說服力。

system.en: The school introduced a new system for borrowing library books.
system.zh: 學校導入了一套新的圖書借閱系統。

take.en: Please take a few minutes to check your answers again.
take.zh: 請花幾分鐘再檢查一次你的答案。

technology.en: New technology has changed the way people communicate across long distances.
technology.zh: 新科技已改變人們進行遠距溝通的方式。

theory.en: The experiment was designed to test whether the theory was correct.
theory.zh: 這個實驗是為了測試該理論是否正確。

there.en: There are several ways to solve this problem correctly.
there.zh: 有好幾種方法可以正確解決這個問題。

therefore.en: The road was closed; therefore, we had to take another route.
therefore.zh: 道路封閉了，因此我們只好改走另一條路。

time.en: We still have enough time to finish the project carefully.
time.zh: 我們還有足夠的時間仔細完成這個專題。

trend.en: The chart shows a clear trend toward greater online learning.
trend.zh: 這張圖表顯示線上學習增加的明顯趨勢。

use.en: Students can use this chart to compare the two results.
use.zh: 學生可以使用這張圖表比較兩個結果。

value.en: The teacher explained the value of checking evidence before making claims.
value.zh: 老師說明了提出主張前查證證據的重要性。

various.en: Students used various sources to complete their research project.
various.zh: 學生使用各種資料來源完成研究專題。

vary.en: Study methods may vary depending on the subject and the student.
vary.zh: 讀書方法可能因科目與學生而有所不同。

water.en: Remember to drink enough water during long study sessions.
water.zh: 長時間讀書時要記得喝足夠的水。

well.en: She explained the difficult idea so well that everyone understood it.
well.zh: 她把困難的觀念解釋得很好，因此大家都懂了。

while.en: I listened to music while I was cleaning my room.
while.zh: 我整理房間時一邊聽音樂。

work.en: Group projects work best when everyone has a clear role.
work.zh: 每個人都有明確分工時，小組專題最容易順利進行。

world.en: The internet allows people around the world to share information quickly.
world.zh: 網路讓世界各地的人能快速分享資訊。

year.en: Our school holds a science fair once every year.
year.zh: 我們學校每年舉辦一次科展。

amazing.en: The team made amazing progress after practicing together every day.
amazing.zh: 團隊每天一起練習後，取得了驚人的進步。

anymore.en: We do not use that old system anymore because it is inefficient.
anymore.zh: 我們已不再使用那套舊系統，因為它效率不佳。

automatically.en: The app automatically saves your progress after each completed activity.
automatically.zh: 這個應用程式會在每項活動完成後自動儲存進度。

autumn.en: The weather becomes cooler and drier during autumn in many regions.
autumn.zh: 許多地區到了秋季，天氣會變得較涼爽乾燥。
